source_note: Standard numbers, titles and scope statements in this dataset are compiled from publicly available BIS catalogue summaries for demonstration purposes. Edition years, amendment numbers and status values are indicative and MUST be re-verified against the live BIS catalogue before any procurement decision.
verification_status: Not verified against live BIS catalogue. Validation source: Curated demo dataset.
disclaimer: This is a DEMO / CURATED DATASET. It does not constitute legal, regulatory or certification advice. Recommendations must be reviewed by the responsible procurement and technical authority.

standards.title: Specification for switchgear and controlgear assemblies for voltages not exceeding 1000 V, Part 1: General requirements
standards.scope: Applies to low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies for indoor and outdoor use, including type-tested and partially type-tested assemblies, used for generation, transmission, distribution and control of electric energy at voltages not exceeding 1000 V AC or 1500 V DC.
testing: verification of short circuit withstand strength
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence for applicable products

standards.title: Specification for switchgear and controlgear assemblies for voltages not exceeding 1000 V, Part 2: Particular requirements for busbar trunking systems (busways)
standards.scope: Specifies particular requirements for busbar trunking systems (busways) for rated voltages not exceeding 1000 V AC or 1500 V DC, covering housings, conductors, tap-off units and installation of prefabricated distribution systems.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence for applicable products

standards.title: General requirements for switchgear and controlgear for voltages not exceeding 1000 V
standards.scope: Lays down general requirements for low voltage switchgear and controlgear devices, including definitions, ratings, design and construction requirements, test conditions and marking for devices used at voltages not exceeding 1000 V.
requirements: rated short circuit making and breaking capacity
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence for applicable products

standards.title: Low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies, Part 1: General rules
standards.scope: Gives general rules for assemblies of low-voltage switchgear and controlgear, including type tests, routine tests, design and construction verification, temperature rise limits and short-circuit withstand requirements.
testing: design verification by comparison with a tested reference design
safety: protection of persons against electric shock
installation: installation in accordance with manufacturer instructions
certification: Referenced for type testing and certification of assemblies

standards.title: Low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies, Part 2: Power switchgear and controlgear assemblies
standards.scope: Specifies particular requirements for power switchgear and controlgear assemblies, supplementing the general rules of Part 1, for assemblies intended for the distribution and control of electrical energy.
certification: Referenced for type testing of power assemblies

standards.title: Specification for miniature circuit breakers
standards.scope: Applies to miniature circuit breakers (MCBs) for a.c. 50 Hz and 60 Hz, rated voltage not exceeding 440 V (phase to earth) and rated current not exceeding 125 A, primarily intended for protection against overloads and short circuits in household and similar installations.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for circuit-breakers for overcurrent protection for household and similar installations
standards.scope: Applies to a.c. air-break circuit-breakers for operation at 50 Hz or 60 Hz, rated voltage not exceeding 440 V (phase to earth), rated current not exceeding 125 A and rated short circuit capacity not exceeding 25 kA, for household and similar installations.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for fuses for voltages not exceeding 1000 V a.c. and 1500 V d.c., Part 1: General requirements
standards.scope: Specifies general requirements for fuses used for protection of electrical circuits at voltages not exceeding 1000 V a.c. and 1500 V d.c., including rated currents, breaking capacities, characteristics and test methods.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence for applicable products

standards.title: Code of practice for earthing
standards.scope: Provides a comprehensive code of practice for the design and installation of earthing systems for electrical installations, covering earth electrodes, earth conductors, earthing conductors, earth resistance requirements and measurement.
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Code of practice for electrical wiring installations
standards.scope: Covers the essential requirements of electrical wiring installations for buildings and structures, including wiring systems, accessories, protective devices, earthing and inspection and testing of installations on completion.
requirements: conductor sizing and current carrying capacity
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Specification for PVC insulated (heavy duty) electric cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: Covers PVC insulated, unsheathed and sheathed cables with or without armour, using solid or stranded aluminium or copper conductors, for rated voltages up to and including 1100 V, intended for use in industrial, domestic and similar installations.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for crosslinked polyethylene insulated PVC sheathed cables, Part 1: For working voltages up to and including 1100 V
standards.scope: Covers XLPE insulated and PVC sheathed cables with or without armour, aluminium or copper conductor, for working voltages up to and including 1100 V, offering higher continuous temperature ratings than PVC insulated cables.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Recommended current ratings for PVC insulated and PVC sheathed heavy duty cables
standards.scope: Gives recommended current ratings for PVC insulated and PVC sheathed heavy duty cables with aluminium or copper conductors, for voltages up to and including 1100 V, under specified installation conditions in air and in ground.
testing: Referenced for design calculations rather than direct testing
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Dimensions of copper and aluminium conductors for insulated electric cables and flexible cords
standards.scope: Specifies the nominal cross-sectional areas and the corresponding dimensions of solid and stranded copper and aluminium conductors used in insulated electric cables and flexible cords.
certification: Referenced as a dimensional standard

standards.title: Specification for distribution transformers up to and including 2500 kVA, 33 kV
standards.scope: Covers oil filled hermetically sealed and breather type distribution transformers of three phase ratings up to and including 2500 kVA at 33 kV, intended for distribution networks, including ratings, tests and performance requirements.
testing: no load loss and no load current test
load loss and impedance voltage test
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence for applicable ratings

standards.title: Specification for power transformers, Part 1: General
standards.scope: Applies to three phase and single phase power transformers (including auto transformers) for system voltages up to and including 765 kV, covering service conditions, ratings, general requirements and test methods.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence for applicable ratings

standards.title: Specification for power transformers, Part 1: General (superseded edition)
standards.scope: Earlier edition of the general requirements for power transformers. Retained in the dataset to demonstrate superseded-edition detection; it should not be cited in new procurement specifications.
certification: Superseded edition; do not cite for new procurement

standards.title: Specification for dry-type power transformers
standards.scope: Covers dry-type power and distribution transformers of ratings up to 1600 kVA for use in indoor installations where oil-filled transformers are unsuitable, including class of insulation, temperature rise and test requirements.
testing: no load and load loss tests
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence for applicable ratings

standards.title: Specification for ordinary Portland cement, 33 grade
standards.scope: Covers the manufacture, chemical and physical requirements, and methods of sampling and testing for ordinary Portland cement 33 grade used for general concrete construction where higher strength grades are not required.
testing: determination of fineness by air permeability
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for ordinary Portland cement, 43 grade
standards.scope: Covers requirements for ordinary Portland cement 43 grade intended for general civil construction and reinforced concrete work where a moderate strength grade is required.
testing: determination of fineness by air permeability
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for Portland slag cement
standards.scope: Covers Portland slag cement manufactured by intimately intergrinding Portland cement clinker and granulated blast furnace slag, including chemical, physical and strength requirements.
testing: determination of fineness by air permeability
installation: curing requirements for slag cement concrete
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for Portland pozzolana cement, Part 1: Fly ash based
standards.scope: Covers Portland pozzolana cement manufactured by grinding together Portland cement clinker and fly ash, including chemical, physical and strength requirements for general construction use.
testing: determination of fineness by air permeability
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for sulphate resisting Portland cement
standards.scope: Covers sulphate resisting Portland cement intended for use in structures exposed to sulphate attack, with restricted tricalcium aluminate content and defined strength requirements.
testing: determination of fineness by air permeability
installation: curing and mix design for aggressive environments
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Methods of physical tests for hydraulic cement, Part 1: Determination of fineness by air permeability method
standards.scope: Specifies the air permeability (Blaine) method for determining the fineness of hydraulic cement, including apparatus, calibration and test procedure.
certification: Referenced test method; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Methods of physical tests for hydraulic cement, Part 6: Determination of compressive strength of hydraulic cement (other than masonry cement)
standards.scope: Specifies the method for determining the compressive strength of standard sand mortar prisms made with hydraulic cement, including specimen preparation, curing and testing at specified ages.
testing: compressive strength test at specified ages
certification: Referenced test method; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Specification for hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel
standards.scope: Covers hot rolled medium and high tensile structural steel plates, sections, flats, strips and bars for use in structural and general engineering purposes, including grades, chemical composition, mechanical properties and test requirements.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for high strength deformed steel bars and wires for concrete reinforcement
standards.scope: Covers high strength deformed steel bars and wires, plain as well as indented, for use as reinforcement in concrete, including grades Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550 and Fe 600 with chemical and mechanical requirements.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for mild steel and medium tensile steel bars and hard drawn steel wire for use in concrete, Part 1: Mild steel and medium tensile steel bars
standards.scope: Covers mild steel and medium tensile steel bars for use as reinforcement in plain and lightly reinforced concrete, including grades, dimensions and mechanical requirements.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for hot rolled steel sheet, strip and plates for structural and general engineering purposes
standards.scope: Covers hot rolled carbon steel sheet, strip and plate supplied in various conditions for structural and general engineering applications, including dimensional tolerances and mechanical properties.
requirements: yield and tensile strength by grade
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: General construction in steel - Code of practice (third revision)
standards.scope: Provides a code of practice for the design, fabrication and erection of steel structures using limit state design methods, covering materials, loads, member design, connections and fabrication requirements.
applications: fabrication of steel enclosures and frames
requirements: tension, compression, bending and shear design
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Code of practice for use of metal arc welding for general construction in mild steel
standards.scope: Provides guidance on the use of manual metal arc welding for general construction in mild steel, covering joint design, electrode selection, welding procedure and workmanship requirements.
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Metallic materials - Tensile testing at ambient temperature
standards.scope: Specifies the method for tensile testing of metallic materials at ambient temperature, including test pieces, apparatus, test procedure and determination of yield and tensile properties.
certification: Referenced test method; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Specification for high strength structural steel bolts
standards.scope: Covers high strength structural steel bolts, nuts and washers for use in steel structures, including grades, dimensions, mechanical properties and galvanising requirements.
installation: bolt tightening to specified torque or turn of nut
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Technical supply conditions for threaded steel fasteners, Part 1: General requirements for bolts, screws and studs
standards.scope: Covers the technical supply conditions for threaded steel fasteners including property classes, dimensions, tolerances, mechanical properties and acceptance requirements.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Plain and reinforced concrete - Code of practice (fourth revision)
standards.scope: Provides a code of practice for the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete, covering materials, mix design, durability, design, construction practice and workmanship.
safety: cover to prevent corrosion of reinforcement
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Concrete structures for the storage of liquids, Part 2: Reinforced concrete structures
standards.scope: Covers the design and construction of reinforced concrete structures for the storage of liquids, including water retaining structures, with requirements for impermeability, cracking and jointing.
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Coarse and fine aggregates for concrete - Specification
standards.scope: Covers the requirements for coarse and fine aggregates from natural sources for use in mass and reinforced concrete, including grading, impurities, deleterious materials and strength requirements.
requirements: particle size distribution and grading zones
testing: specific gravity and water absorption test
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Methods of tests for strength of concrete
standards.scope: Covers the methods of sampling, making, curing and testing concrete specimens for compressive, flexural and splitting tensile strength, including sampling procedures and acceptance criteria.
testing: compressive strength test of cubes and cylinders
certification: Referenced test method; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Methods of sampling and analysis of concrete
standards.scope: Covers the methods of sampling fresh concrete and the tests for workability of fresh concrete, including slump, compaction factor and Vee-Bee consistometer tests.
certification: Referenced test method; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Non-destructive testing of concrete, Part 1: Ultrasonic pulse velocity
standards.scope: Covers the method of assessing the quality of concrete in structures by measuring the velocity of an ultrasonic pulse passing through it, including apparatus, procedure and interpretation.
certification: Referenced test method; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Code of practice for painting of ferrous metals in buildings, Part 1: Pretreatment and painting
standards.scope: Provides recommendations for the preparation of ferrous metal surfaces and the application of protective paint systems in buildings, including pretreatment, primers, finishing coats and inspection.
requirements: primer selection and dry film thickness
safety: ventilation and fire safety during painting
installation: surface preparation by blasting or manual cleaning
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Design loads (other than earthquake) for buildings and structures, Part 3: Wind loads
standards.scope: Deals with the determination of wind loads on buildings and structures, including wind speed zones, terrain and height factors, pressure coefficients and force coefficients.
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Criteria for earthquake resistant design of structures, Part 1: General provisions and buildings
standards.scope: Lays down criteria for earthquake resistant design of structures, including seismic zones, design spectrum, importance factors, and general principles for buildings and other structures.
applications: design of equipment and its anchorage
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Ductile design and detailing of reinforced concrete structures subjected to seismic forces - Code of practice
standards.scope: Provides requirements for ductile design and detailing of reinforced concrete members and structures subjected to seismic forces, covering beams, columns, joints and special confining reinforcement.
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Code of practice for water supply in buildings
standards.scope: Covers the requirements for the design, installation and testing of water supply systems in buildings, including sources of supply, storage, distribution, pipe sizing and backflow prevention.
safety: prevention of contamination of potable water
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Code of basic requirements for water supply, drainage and sanitation (fourth revision)
standards.scope: Lays down the basic requirements for water supply, drainage and sanitation for buildings, covering water demand, drainage loads, sanitary appliances and general layout principles.
testing: air test and water test of drainage
installation: layout of soil and waste pipes
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Code of practice for laying of service pipes for water supply
standards.scope: Covers the requirements for laying, jointing, testing and commissioning of service pipes for water supply, including trenching, bedding, thrust blocks and backfill.
testing: hydrostatic pressure test of laid pipe
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Code of practice for plumbing in multi-storeyed buildings, Part 1: Water supply
standards.scope: Covers plumbing practice for water supply in multi-storeyed buildings, including direct and indirect pumping systems, riser layouts, overhead tanks and pressure management.
safety: prevention of pipe burst under excess pressure
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Specification for unplasticized PVC pipes for water supply
standards.scope: Covers unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pipes for use in water supply systems, including sizes, pressure ratings, material requirements, physical properties and test methods.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for polyethylene pipes for water supply, Part 1: General requirements
standards.scope: Covers polyethylene pipes for water supply systems, including grades of material, sizes, pressure ratings, physical properties and test methods.
requirements: mean outside diameter and wall thickness
installation: snaking in trench for temperature movement
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Specification for flushing cisterns for water closets and urinals
standards.scope: Covers flushing cisterns for water closets and urinals, including materials, capacity, operating mechanism, water tightness and performance requirements.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Safety footwear, Part 1: Safety shoes
standards.scope: Specifies requirements, test methods and marking for safety shoes intended to protect the wearer against impact, compression and puncture hazards in industrial workplaces.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Industrial safety helmets
standards.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for industrial safety helmets intended to provide protection against falling objects and lateral impact for workers in industry and construction.
safety: protection against accidental contact with live conductors
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Safety belts and harnesses
standards.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for safety belts and harnesses used for personal protection against falls from height in industrial and construction work.
requirements: static strength of webbing and stitching
installation: correct wearing and pre use inspection
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Industrial safety gloves: Leather mittens
standards.scope: Specifies requirements, materials and test methods for leather mittens used as industrial safety gloves for protection against abrasion, cuts and handling hazards.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Eye protectors
standards.scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for eye protectors including spectacles, goggles and face shields intended to protect the eyes against impact, dust, splash and radiation hazards.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Grey iron castings (third revision)
standards.scope: Covers grey iron castings for general engineering purposes, including grades, chemical composition, mechanical properties, dimensions and test requirements.
testing: tensile test on cast test bars
safety: pressure tightness for fluid containing castings
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Carbon steel castings for general engineering purposes
standards.scope: Covers carbon steel castings for general engineering purposes, including grades, chemical composition, heat treatment, mechanical properties and test requirements.
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Code for unfired pressure vessels
standards.scope: Covers the design, fabrication, inspection and testing of unfired pressure vessels made of ferrous materials, including shells, heads, openings and supports.
testing: radiography and ultrasonic examination of welds
magnetic particle or dye penetrant test
installation: relief valve installation and discharge piping
certification: Referenced as a code of practice; not a product certification standard

standards.title: Mild steel tubes and tubulars and other wrought steel fittings, Part 1: Mild steel tubes (400 mm nominal outside diameter)
standards.scope: Covers mild steel tubes for use in pressure piping, water and steam lines, and structural applications, including dimensions, mass, mechanical properties and test requirements.
requirements: outside diameter and wall thickness tolerance
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Steel tubes for structural purposes
standards.scope: Covers steel tubes of circular, square and rectangular sections for structural purposes, including grades, dimensions, mechanical properties and test requirements.
requirements: yield and tensile strength by grade
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence

standards.title: Information technology equipment - Safety, Part 1: General requirements
standards.scope: Specifies the safety requirements for information technology equipment, including electrical and energy hazards, fire, heat and mechanical hazards, intended to reduce the risk of injury to users and service personnel.
testing: strain relief and cord anchor test
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence for applicable equipment

standards.title: Audio, video and similar electronic apparatus - Safety requirements
standards.scope: Applies to the safety requirements for audio, video and similar electronic apparatus intended for domestic and general indoor use, covering electric shock, energy, fire, heat and mechanical hazards.
testing: abnormal operation and fault condition test
certification: ISI mark available under BIS Certification Marks Licence
